decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY permitting connector placement on the proposed sides while preserving the explicit edge and grouping constraints.
Removing the legacy main-board form-factor constraint does not alter the independently specified antenna orientation or minimum keepout.
A same-message MODIFY already marks the legacy power-board access rules inapplicable and removes their obsolete placement and clearance attributes.
The candidate already specifies a single integrated board; the source merely relies on that existing topology and introduces no further topology change.
The source relaxes physical placement constraints but does not cancel or modify the previously requested legacy-board manufacturing artifact.
The cost, component-selection, integrated-board, and connector-reduction policies remain valid unchanged.
Physical placement flexibility does not entail any change to DCDC1 voltage regulation or Schottky-drop compensation.
The source does not change which rails must be monitored, the monitor device, or the required downstream measurement coverage.
The source does not alter standalone USB powering, source selection, regulator capacity, or the powered 3.3V loads.
The charge-status behavior and external LED interface remain independently required; the source establishes no electrical or interface change.

The phrase 'only one board + sensors/buttons/leds' could mean the separate LED daughterboard is obsolete or could merely describe it collectively as positioned LEDs; the source does not safely resolve its lifecycle or replacement form.

The panel-button behavior and PWRON connection remain valid; the source does not necessarily change the connector's logical board location because the integrated PCB may still serve as the main board.
